items.exampleEn: Her English has improved tremendously this year.
items.exampleZh: 她今年的英文進步非常多。

items.exampleEn: The camera can magnify things up to fifty times.
items.exampleZh: 這台相機可以把東西放大到五十倍。

items.exampleEn: The music was amplified so the whole park could hear it.
items.exampleZh: 音樂經過放大，整座公園都聽得到。

items.exampleEn: It is hard to quantify the value of good teamwork.
items.exampleZh: 良好團隊合作的價值很難量化。

items.exampleEn: The files are kept in numerical order.
items.exampleZh: 這些檔案按數字順序存放。

items.exampleEn: Please give all the measurements in metric units.
items.exampleZh: 請把所有尺寸都用公制單位標示。

items.exampleEn: Could I have just a sliver of cake?
items.exampleZh: 我可以只要一小片蛋糕嗎？

items.exampleEn: I need to lengthen these trousers a little.
items.exampleZh: 這條褲子我得稍微放長一點。

items.sentenceEn: Our sales grew tremendously after we opened the online shop.
items.sentenceZh: 我們開了網路商店之後，銷售大幅成長。

items.audioEn: The microphone is broken, so we can't amplify the speaker's voice.
items.audioZh: 麥克風壞了，所以我們沒辦法把講者的聲音放大。
items.questionZh: 為什麼沒辦法把講者的聲音放大？

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather uses a special glass to magnify small print.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺用一種特別的鏡片來放大小字。

items.sentenceEn: In summer, the days lengthen and the nights get shorter.
items.sentenceZh: 夏天時，白天變長，夜晚變短。

items.stemEn: The scientists tried to ____ the amount of plastic in the sea.
items.stemZh: 科學家們試著量化海裡塑膠的數量。

items.stemEn: Most countries use the ____ system, but a few still use miles and pounds.
items.stemZh: 大多數國家使用公制，但仍有少數國家使用英里和磅。

items.passageEn: Our small company sells kitchen tools online, and last year we decided to sell overseas. We soon found that not every country uses the metric system, so we had to change the size labels for each market. We also had to quantify our costs thoroughly. Shipping prices rose tremendously, so we switched to a slower but cheaper service and lengthened our delivery time from three days to a week. We gave every product a numerical code, and our sales data showed that one product sold best: a thin knife that can cut a sliver of cheese as thin as paper. To amplify its success, we made a short video. In the video, a magnifying glass showed how sharp the knife was.
items.passageZh: 我們這家小公司在網路上賣廚房用具，去年決定開始外銷。我們很快就發現，並不是每個國家都用公制，所以得為每個市場修改尺寸標籤。我們也必須徹底量化成本。運費大幅上漲，所以我們改用比較慢但比較便宜的運送方式，把送貨時間從三天延長到一週。我們給每項產品一個數字代碼，銷售數據顯示有一項產品賣得最好：一把很薄的刀，能把起司切成像紙一樣薄的薄片。為了擴大它的成功，我們拍了一支短片。影片中用放大鏡顯示這把刀有多鋒利。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼把送貨時間延長？

items.promptZh: 我們決定把會議延長半小時。
referenceEn: We decided to lengthen the meeting by half an hour.
We decided to lengthen the meeting by thirty minutes.
rubricZh: lengthen 表示「延長、加長」，延長多少可用 by…（例如 lengthen the meeting by half an hour）
寫 extend the meeting 意思也對；時態用過去式或現在完成式都可以（例如 decided、have decided）

items.promptZh: 我非常欽佩我祖母的勇氣。
referenceEn: I admire my grandmother's courage tremendously.
I tremendously admire my grandmother for her courage.
rubricZh: tremendously 表示「極大地」，可放句尾或動詞前（例如 admire … tremendously 等）
